label: saracamp2
title_zh: 我一直在想离开这个地方

lines.en: label saracamp2:
scene black
I think I’ve done enough for today.
lines.zh: 我觉得我今天做得够多了。

lines.en: In fact, this is probably the most I’ve done at all since I was in the shape and state required to attend similar events hosted by my class.
lines.zh: 事实上，这大概是我自打还有那个体型和状态、去参加班上办的类似活动以来，做得最多的一次。

lines.en: I wonder how those work without me.
lines.zh: 我在想，没有我，那些活动是怎么办成的。

lines.en: But that shouldn’t come as much of a surprise as my narcissism seldom allows me to comprehend how anything works without me.
lines.zh: 但这不该太让人意外——我的自恋很少允许我去理解，没有我的时候，任何东西是怎么运转的。

lines.en: Even acknowledging that, though, I can’t help but feel like there’s something missing despite everything I’ve accomplished during my brief time here.
lines.zh: 不过即便承认了这一点，我还是忍不住觉得，尽管我在这片短暂的时光里完成了一切，还是缺了点什么。

lines.en: It was just one day, but it felt like two. So is this sudden and apparent emptiness the result of me wanting to stretch that two into a three? Maybe a three into a four?
lines.zh: 明明只过了一天，却感觉像两天。那么，这份突然而明显的空虚，是不是因为我想把那个「两天」拉成「三天」？也许再把「三天」拉成「四天」？

lines.en: I shrug my shoulders as I unzip the mouth of my shelter and allow it to swallow me.
lines.zh: 我耸耸肩，拉开我那栖身之所的嘴，任它把我吞下去。

lines.en: Everyone else has hurried off to sleep already and I look on in awe as my niece is digested before my very eyes.
lines.zh: 其他人早就赶着睡了，而我敬畏地看着我的侄女在我眼前被消化。

lines.en: I don’t call her my daughter internally because it still hasn’t set in yet.
lines.zh: 我没有在心里把她叫成我女儿，因为那还没沉淀下来。

lines.en: All I know is that she’s cute. And so I watch her sleep for approximately seven minutes before opening up a second mouth inside of the mouth and crawling into that one.
lines.zh: 我只知道她很可爱。于是我看着她睡了大约七分钟，然后在那张嘴里面又张开第二张嘴，爬进了那一张里。

lines.en: I think I like camping.
lines.zh: 我觉得我喜欢露营。

lines.en: I think I like being out here where the only people I can hurt are people who have already been hurt before.
lines.zh: 我觉得我喜欢待在这儿——在这里，我唯一能伤害的人，是那些早就被伤害过的人。

lines.en: It alleviates some of the pressure of simply existing and grants me the strength I need to not be chewed in half by my sleeping bag.
lines.zh: 它减轻了我仅仅是「存在」这件事带来的压力，也给了我足够的力气，不至于被睡袋咬成两半。

lines.en: When I close my eyes, I think of Heaven.
lines.zh: 当我闭上眼睛，我想到了天堂。

lines.en: I think of how it must appear. Or if it ever will appear. Because I want it to appear.
lines.zh: 我想它该是什么样子。或者它到底会不会出现。因为我想要它出现。

lines.en: But I also worry that days like this are the closest I’ll ever come to experiencing such a thing.
lines.zh: 但我也担心，像这样的日子，已经是我这辈子最接近体验那种东西的时刻了。

lines.en: My final thought before falling asleep is that I want to do this again.
lines.zh: 入睡前我最后的念头是：我还想再来一次。

lines.en: I just want to do it alone next time.
lines.zh: 只是下次我想一个人来。

lines.en: I want to be one with the forest.
lines.zh: 我想与森林融为一体。

lines.en: I want it to swallow me.
lines.zh: 我想让它把我吞下去。

lines.en: Goodnight, Moon.
lines.zh: 晚安，月亮。

lines.en: $ totaldays += 1
$ day = 1
show monday
scene sky
: Is it faster if I take this left?
lines.zh: : 我在这儿左转会更快吗？

lines.en: : That road’s closed for construction. But you can follow this one straight for three more lights and then turn left at that one.
lines.zh: : 那条路因为施工封了。不过你可以沿着这条直走过三个红绿灯，然后在那个路口左转。

lines.en: : Weird. I don’t remember seeing any construction at all on our way to pick you guys up.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我们来接你们的时候，我完全不记得路上有在施工。

lines.en: : You were probably just so excited to spend time with your newest daughter that you overlooked it.
lines.zh: : 你大概是太兴奋能跟自己最新的女儿待在一起了，所以没注意。

lines.en: : What are they even building over here? It’s not another porn shop is it? Am I going to have to fight another small business owner to defend my turf? You’ll help- won’t you, Haru-kun?
lines.zh: : 他们到底在这儿建什么？不会又是家色情用品店吧？我是不是得再跟一个小老板打一架来守住我的地盘？你会帮我的——对吧，Haru-kun？

lines.en: : Sure, Maki. I’ll fight a rival porn dealer for you.
lines.zh: : 当然，Maki。我会为你去打一个竞争对手的色情贩子。

lines.en: : I’ll help too! I can be scrappy.
lines.zh: : 我也会帮忙！我可不好惹。

lines.en: : No, you’re too small. You’ll only get in the way.
lines.zh: : 不行，你太小了。只会碍事。

lines.en: : I hadn’t noticed any of this either. Do you know what’s going on, Ami?
lines.zh: : 这些我也都没注意到。你知道是怎么回事吗，Ami？

lines.en: : Mm...just more houses, I think? Maybe a closer convenience store if we’re lucky.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概又是些房子吧？运气好的话，也许是家更近的便利店。

lines.en: : That sure sounds like it’d be convenient to me.
lines.zh: : 听上去对我来说确实挺方便的。

lines.en: : Maki, drive faster.
lines.zh: : Maki，开快点。

lines.en: : Maki, don’t.
lines.zh: : Maki，别开快。

lines.en: : But if we don’t get there soon, Sara might try to make another joke.
lines.zh: : 可要是我们不快点到，Sara 可能又要讲笑话了。

lines.en: : Was that a joke? I thought it was more of an observation than anything.
lines.zh: : 那是笑话吗？我觉得那更像是句评论。

lines.en: : It was obviously a joke! It’s not my fault that none of you appreciate good humor. Right, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那明显是个笑话！你们不懂得欣赏好笑话，可不是我的错。对吧，Ami？

lines.en: : Hm? What was the joke? I must have missed it.
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么笑话？我大概是错过了。

lines.en: : Ugh! Never mind! Maki, drive faster!
lines.zh: : 呃！算了！Maki，开快点！

lines.en: It’s the morning after, if you couldn’t already tell.
lines.zh: 如果你还没看出来的话——这是第二天早上。

lines.en: Our trip has come to an end and the time has come for us to bid farewell to camaraderie and get back to our old, boring lives.
lines.zh: 我们的旅程结束了，是时候告别这份同袍之谊，回到我们各自无聊的老日子里去。

lines.en: I’m starting to think mine might be a little less boring from now on, though. But there’s still one problem-
lines.zh: 不过我开始觉得，我的日子从今往后也许会不那么无聊一点。但还有一个问题——

lines.en: I don’t know what to do about Niki.
lines.zh: 我不知道该拿 Niki 怎么办。

lines.en: I’ve obviously had several chances to talk to Ami about her proposition but, I...may have prioritized something else.
lines.zh: 我显然有过好几次机会跟 Ami 谈她的提议，但我……可能把别的事放在了前面。

lines.en: Something with a more immediate impact on the way I’m thinking as opposed to something that would have to take place in the future.
lines.zh: 那件别的事对我此刻的思考方式有更直接的影响，而不是那种得等到将来才会发生的事。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure that’s okay, though. And I’m pretty sure Niki would be proud of me for taking the step I took last night.
lines.zh: 不过我很确定这没关系。而且我很确定，Niki 会为我昨晚迈出的那一步感到骄傲。

lines.en: I know Ami’s proud of me, that’s for sure. But I also know that she’d be proud of me if I decided I was a cat one day and started dropping dead mice at her feet.
lines.zh: 我知道 Ami 为我骄傲，这点毫无疑问。但我也知道，就算我哪天决定自己是一只猫、开始往她脚边丢死老鼠，她也会为我骄傲。

lines.en: Suffice it to say, her pride comes easy. Niki’s comes at a cost.
lines.zh: 可以说，她的骄傲来得很便宜。Niki 的骄傲是有代价的。

lines.en: And mine is a giant invisible force-field covering every inch of my body in a way that makes me forget it’s even there.
lines.zh: 而我的骄傲，是一层巨大的隐形力场，覆盖着我身体的每一寸，让我甚至忘了它在那儿。

lines.en: scene black
When we pull up to the house, Sara gets out of the car as well and follows Ami and me to the door.
lines.zh: 我们把车停到屋前时，Sara 也下了车，跟着我和 Ami 走到门口。

lines.en: Originally, I think it’s just to give her the chance to say goodbye and...hug us or whatever. But I quickly realize that’s not the case when Maki speeds off.
lines.zh: 我本来以为，她只是想有机会道个别、还有……抱抱我们什么的。但当 Maki 一脚油门窜走时，我很快意识到并非如此。

lines.en: She smiles at me, silently asking to be invited in. So I silently respond by opening the door as a low-effort way to repay her for opening one yesterday.
lines.zh: 她朝我微笑，无声地请求被邀请进去。于是我无声地回应，把门打开，作为一种低成本的回报——回报她昨天也为我打开了一扇门。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse1
: Did you have fun yesterday, Ami?
lines.zh: : 昨天玩得开心吗，Ami？

lines.en: : Yeah...and thanks again for making me...not so hideous anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯……还有，再次谢谢你让我……不再那么难看了。

lines.en: : Thank me again once you can get rid of those dark circles. Or just come visit me so I can see the finished product.
lines.zh: : 等你把黑眼圈去掉了再谢我吧。或者干脆来找我，好让我看看成品。

lines.en: : Maybe don’t invite my niece out to the bar, Sara.
lines.zh: : 也许别邀请我侄女去酒吧，Sara。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse2
: You’re still calling her that after yesterday? Did we fail our mission after all?
lines.zh: : 过了昨天，你还管她叫那个？我们的任务终究还是失败了？

lines.en: : Oh. Shit.
lines.zh: : 哦。靠。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I imagine it’ll take some getting used to. Besides, it’s not like you’re technically wrong. And I don’t really care what you call me.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我想这需要点时间适应。再说，严格来说你也没叫错。而且我真不太在乎你怎么叫我。

lines.en: : We can...take it slow or...
lines.zh: : 我们可以……慢慢来，或者……

lines.en: scene saraamishouse3
: Yeah...
: Are you doing anything later tonight, Ami? Maybe you, me, and Sana could go out to dinner or something? That wouldn’t be too weird, would it?
lines.zh: : Ami，你今晚晚点有事吗？也许你、我，还有 Sana 可以出去吃个饭什么的？那不会太奇怪吧？

lines.en: scene saraamishouse4
: Maybe another time. I already told one of my friends I’d meet up with them and...probably shouldn’t immediately back out.
lines.zh: : 改天吧。我已经跟一个朋友说好要见面了，而且……大概不该马上放人家鸽子。

lines.en: : Wait, you did? Are you sure you’re ready for that? It’s not too soon? You don’t want to...stay inside for a few more days?
lines.zh: : 等等，你说了？你确定你已经准备好了？会不会太快了？你不想……再在家里待几天？

lines.en: scene saraamishouse5
: Weren’t you literally just trying to get me to start leaving the house again yesterday? I’m a burden to you if I stay here and we both know that.
lines.zh: : 你昨天不是还在拼命想让我重新出门吗？我留在这儿对你来说是个负担，我们俩都清楚。

lines.en: : But that still doesn’t mean I expect you to start acting normal again after one outing and-
lines.zh: : 可那也不代表我指望你出去一次就开始表现得像个正常人，而且——

lines.en: : It’s fine. It’s just Maya I’m meeting up with anyway.
lines.zh: : 没事的。反正我见的也只是 Maya。

lines.en: scene nodokontest6
scene saraamishouse5
: Ah.
scene saraamishouse6
: Then maybe me and you could go out to dinner?
lines.zh: : 那也许我和你可以出去吃个饭？

lines.en: : Sara, I like you. And I want to thank you again for yesterday. But please — don’t push it.
lines.zh: : Sara，我喜欢你。也想再次谢谢你昨天做的一切。但是拜托——别得寸进尺。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse7
: Hey, you were my first pick! Sensei’s just the backup! You know where my heart really lies!
lines.zh: : 嘿，你可是我的第一选择！Sensei 只是备胎！你知道我的心真正属于谁！

lines.en: scene saraamishouse8
: That’s only because the quickest way to a man’s heart is through his daughter. And if you win me over, you think you’ll win him as well. Don’t think I don’t know your games, Sara.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为通往男人心最短的路，是透过他的女儿。而你要是赢了我，就觉得也能赢得他。别以为我不知道你在玩什么把戏，Sara。

lines.en: : Can I not want both of those things? Why does it have to be one or the other?
lines.zh: : 我不能两个都想要吗？为什么非得二选一？

lines.en: : Just give it a rest, Sara. Ami’s not letting you out of this one.
lines.zh: : 别闹了，Sara。这次 Ami 不会放过你的。

lines.en: : Right you are, Dad.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，爸爸。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse9
: You can have him for a few minutes, though. I’m gonna go warm the bath up.
lines.zh: : 不过你可以把他借走几分钟。我去把浴缸的热水放上。

lines.en: : Camping is fun and all, but I think I would have preferred a hot spring instead.
lines.zh: : 露营是挺好玩的，不过我觉得我更想去泡温泉。

lines.en: : Hahah...I’ll try to remember that for next time...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……下次我会记住的……

lines.en: scene saraamishouse10

Ami exhibits an extreme amount of growth by leaving me in the room with a woman my age. Either that or she’s cynically and slyly expressing her doubt that I’m sexually interested in older women to begin with.
lines.zh: Ami 展现出了极大的成长——她把我单独留在一个和我同龄的女人身边。要么就是她精明又狡猾地在表达她的怀疑：怀疑我压根对年长的女人没有性趣。

lines.en: Either way, the two of us are left alone as she runs into her room to grab a change of clothes for the bath. But I guess she’s never been that opposed to Sara in the first place.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，当她跑回房间去拿换洗衣服准备洗澡时，就剩我们俩了。不过我想她一开始也从未那么排斥 Sara。

lines.en: And while I want to sit here and ponder why that seems to be the case, I’m worried that doing so will lead me down a road I don’t want to think of at all.
lines.zh: 虽然我想坐在这儿琢磨为什么会是这样，但我担心那么想会把我带上一条我根本不想去想的路。

lines.en: So I match the tone set by a local bartender and also stand here in silence, waiting for that quiet to be killed off and replaced with something brighter.
lines.zh: 于是我配合起一个本地酒保定下的调子，也这么站在沉默里，等着这份安静被扼死、被某种更明亮的东西取代。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Welp...I need to head out.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我得走了。

lines.en: : You do? I figured you’d be sticking around for a little while longer considering how you followed us in here.
lines.zh: : 你要走了？我还以为你会多待一会儿呢，毕竟你都跟着我们进来了。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse11
: I really just wanted to say goodbye to Ami. But this is your first day as father and daughter and I probably shouldn’t be getting in the way of that.
lines.zh: : 我真的只是想跟 Ami 道个别。但今天是你作为父亲和女儿的第一天，我大概不该挡道。

lines.en: : It might be the first day in name, but Ami pointed out yesterday that that’s sort of how things have been all along.
lines.zh: : 名义上也许是第一天，但 Ami 昨天指出，事情其实一直都是那样的。

lines.en: : But hey, maybe now I’ll start making better decisions when it comes to her guidance.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，也许从现在起，在指导她这件事上，我会开始做出更好的决定。

lines.en: : I probably won’t, but it’s worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 大概不会吧，但值得一试。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse12
: I know exactly what you mean. I made a ton of mistakes with Sana when she was growing up that I didn’t realize until way later. Heck, even now I’m making mistakes.
lines.zh: : 我完全懂你的意思。Sana 成长的过程中，我犯了一大堆错，很多都是很久以后才意识到的。见鬼，就算现在我也还在犯错。

lines.en: : But we’re only human, Sensei. Being perfect is so far out of the question that all we can really do is hope those mistakes don’t pile up to the point where our girls can’t figure out how to get over them.
lines.zh: : 可我们只是凡人，Sensei。完美根本不在考虑范围内，我们真正能做的，只有希望那些错误不要堆积到让我们的女儿无从跨越。

lines.en: : That’s why I wanted to help with Ami. I know what that fear is like.
lines.zh: : 所以我想帮 Ami。我知道那种恐惧是什么滋味。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse13
: But I guess she’s also right about the “wanting to win you over” part.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，你说「想赢得你」那部分也对。

lines.en: if sarasex == False:
: Sara-
lines.zh: : Sara——

lines.en: scene saraamishouse14
: I know, I know. Your heart lies elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。你的心在别处。

lines.en: : I just wanted to remind you of the life you’re missing out on. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想提醒你，你正在错过多么美好的生活。仅此而已。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse15
: But I’ll be going now.
lines.zh: : 不过我要走了。

lines.en: : I had fun yesterday, Sensei. Even if I was just living in a fantasy for part of it.
lines.zh: : 我昨天玩得很开心，Sensei。哪怕有一部分时间，我只是活在一场幻想里。

lines.en: : I hope you did too.
lines.zh: : 希望你也是。

lines.en: scene black
: And good luck with Ami. Feel free to let me know if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 还有，祝 Ami 那边顺利。需要什么尽管跟我说。

lines.en: : I will. Thanks, Sara.
lines.zh: : 我会的。谢谢，Sara。

lines.en: : And come visit sometime! We miss your face. And your money.
lines.zh: : 有空来玩啊！我们会想你的脸。还有你的钱。

lines.en: : I will. I’ll talk to you later.
lines.zh: : 我会的。回头聊。

lines.en: : Bye! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 拜拜！很快见！

lines.en: Sara exits the house and I-
lines.zh: Sara 走出了屋子，而我——

lines.en: Well, I guess my new-ish life begins.
lines.zh: 好吧，我想我那崭新的——算是崭新的——生活开始了。

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
There’s no way of knowing if this change in my relationship with Ami will actually affect anything, but...I’m going to have to find out eventually.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 关系的这个转变到底会不会真的改变什么，无从得知，但……我总归迟早得弄清楚。

lines.en: else:
: I figured as much. But some might say you’ve already won.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。不过有人会说，你已经赢了。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse15
: And some might say I haven’t. It really comes down to what you’ll do next, Sensei. I’ve done more than enough to prove I’d make an excellent rock for your garden.
lines.zh: : 也有人会说我还没赢。这真的取决于你接下来怎么做，Sensei。我已经做得够多了，足以证明我会是你花园里一块极好的石头。

lines.en: : Probably not the best analogy, Sara. Most gardens have more than one rock in them.
lines.zh: : 这个比喻大概不太妙，Sara。大多数花园里可不止一块石头。

lines.en: : As long as I’m the biggest and the one you look at first, I’m happy.
lines.zh: : 只要我是最大的那块、是你第一眼看到的那块，我就高兴。

lines.en: : Maybe a boulder would be better then. Something you wouldn’t be able to move.
lines.zh: : 那也许该是块巨石。那种你搬不动的。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse14
: But I digress. And now I really have overstayed my welcome.
lines.zh: : 不过我扯远了。而且现在我真的待得太久了。

lines.en: scene black
Sara gives me a quick hug before retreating to the door.
lines.zh: Sara 飞快地抱了我一下，然后退回门口。

lines.en: But when she grabs the handle, I feel the urge to call out to her.
lines.zh: 可当她握住门把手时，我有一股想叫住她的冲动。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse16
: You haven’t overstayed your welcome, Sara.
lines.zh: : 你没有待太久，Sara。

lines.en: : You can come here whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你想什么时候来都行。

lines.en: : I mean it.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。

lines.en: : You’ve been a huge help. And it’s nice having someone on hand who at least sort of knows what they’re doing when it comes to raising a teenager.
lines.zh: : 你帮了大忙。而且在抚养青少年这件事上，身边有个至少还算知道自己在干什么的人，挺好的。

lines.en: : So yeah, drop by whenever.
lines.zh: : 所以是啊，随时过来。

lines.en: : We’d both be happy to see you.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都会很高兴见到你。

lines.en: : Is something wrong. Why are you just-
lines.zh: : 有什么不对吗？你为什么只是——

lines.en: scene black
: That’s not something you should have said to me.
lines.zh: : 你不该对我说那种话的。

lines.en: : But...why not?
lines.zh: : 可是……为什么不该？

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。

lines.en: : Sensei...if you let me come here whenever I want...
lines.zh: : Sensei……如果你让我随时都能来这儿……

lines.en: scene saraamishouse17
: I’d never leave!
lines.zh: : 我就永远都不走了！

lines.en: : Sara?...
lines.zh: : Sara？……

lines.en: scene saraamishouse18
: At least not without you two.
lines.zh: : 至少不会丢下你们俩。

lines.en: : You...
: You’re...not saying you want to move in, are you?
lines.zh: : 你……该不会是想搬进来吧？

lines.en: scene saraamishouse19
: Here? I guess we could make it work if we tried hard enough.
lines.zh: : 这儿？我想我们要是努力一下，总能凑合的。

lines.en: : It might be a little small for four people, but...I don’t need a lot of space. And I’m sure Sana and Ami wouldn’t mind sharing a room for a few years. But if that’s not possible...
lines.zh: : 四个人住可能有点小，但是……我不需要多大空间。而且我确信 Sana 和 Ami 不介意合住一间房几年。不过如果那不可能的话……

lines.en: scene saraamishouse17
: What about the future?
lines.zh: : 那未来呢？

lines.en: : What about the future, Sara?
lines.zh: : 什么未来，Sara？

lines.en: scene saraamishouse20
: I’ve been thinking about leaving this place.
lines.zh: : 我一直在想离开这个地方。

lines.en: : And when I do, I want you to come with me. Ami too, of course.
lines.zh: : 而我走的时候，想让你跟我一起走。Ami 当然也一起。

lines.en: : Somewhere the four of us can be a family. Somewhere on the other side of the wall.
lines.zh: : 找个我们四个能成为一家人的地方。在墙的另一边。

lines.en: : But...we have no way of knowing when that wall will be gone.
lines.zh: : 可是……我们无从得知那堵墙什么时候会消失。

lines.en: : But wouldn’t it be nice to have something to look forward to when it does?
lines.zh: : 可当它真的消失时，有件可以期待的事，不是很好吗？

lines.en: scene saraamishouse17
: Maybe somewhere in the countryside so we could go camping a little more often! Doesn’t that sound great?
lines.zh: : 也许是乡下的某个地方，这样我们就能更常去露营了！听起来是不是很棒？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. But-
lines.zh: : 我是说……是啊。但是——

lines.en: : A family?...
lines.zh: : 一家人？……

lines.en: scene saraamishouse21
: Ami?...How long have you-
lines.zh: : Ami？……你……多久了——

lines.en: : You want the four of us...to be a family?
lines.zh: : 你想让我们四个……成为一家人？

lines.en: : Or more! I’m still young. I wouldn’t mind having another.
lines.zh: : 或者更多！我还年轻。再生一个我也不介意。

lines.en: : With who?
lines.zh: : 跟谁？

lines.en: scene saraamishouse22
: Seriously?
lines.zh: : 认真的吗？

lines.en: : Okay, I guess that’ll just be a topic for another day! But apart from another child, how does that sound to you, Ami?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那这个话题就改天再聊！不过除了再要个孩子，你觉得怎么样，Ami？

lines.en: : Are you okay with leaving Kumon-mi behind? Or would you rather stay here? Because the more I think about it, the more I want to get away.
lines.zh: : 你愿意把 Kumon-mi 抛在身后吗？还是想留在这儿？因为我越想，就越想离开。

lines.en: : And I don’t think there’s anything that would make me happier than taking you two with me.
lines.zh: : 而且我想不出有什么比带上你们俩更能让我幸福的事了。

lines.en: scene saraamishouse23
: Well...what do you have to say about this?
lines.zh: : 那么……你对此有什么要说的吗？

lines.en: : This is all just hypothetical for now, guys. We obviously can’t go anywhere yet.
lines.zh: : 这些现在还只是假设，各位。我们显然哪儿都去不了。

lines.en: : And I don’t want it to sound like I’m trying to force myself into your family or...take the place of anyone, but...
lines.zh: : 而且我不想听起来像是在硬挤进你们的家庭，或者……取代任何人，但是……

lines.en: : It’s just something to think about.
lines.zh: : 只是件值得考虑的事。

lines.en: : I think the four of us could have a nice life together.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们四个可以一起过上不错的生活。

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: scene black
: I think we need to have another talk soon, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们得再谈一次，Ami。

lines.en: Sara exits the house and I-
lines.zh: Sara 走出了屋子，而我——

lines.en: I guess I have one more thing to add to the conversation about Niki that I’ve been fearfully avoiding.
lines.zh: 我想，关于 Niki 的那场我一直害怕、一直在回避的对话，又多了一件要加进去的事。

lines.en: But despite how the weight of these two options presses so heavily against my chest that I can feel the ghost of an old worm, there is one positive to come from them.
lines.zh: 但尽管这两个选项的重量压在我胸口，重到我能感觉到一条旧虫的鬼影，它们还是带来了一个好处。

lines.en: It’s the idea that there are people who will love my niece even if I’m gone.
lines.zh: 那就是：就算我不在了，也会有人爱我的侄女。

lines.en: Sorry.
lines.zh: 抱歉。

lines.en: Daughter.
lines.zh: 女儿。

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
But apart from that...I guess it’s time to try and force a little more normalcy back into my life as well.
lines.zh: 但除此之外……我想，也是时候给我的生活再强行塞回一点正常了。

lines.en: Even if it’s just one step at a time.
lines.zh: 哪怕一次只能迈一步。
